method: HTTP GET byte equality and Chrome rendered DOM; no application POST or inference call

/.score_explanation: What this score is: An estimate from 1,911 human pairwise votes on 2024-era AI videos of how often prompts like yours received a vote rejecting both clips. Not a calibrated probability for today’s models (held-out AUC about 0.67). Machine feedback can make the displayed score a mixed heuristic proxy, while the original human votes remain separate.
/.clip_explanation: What the clip review is: Gemini gives a visual opinion on the clip and sampled frames, with timecodes you can inspect. Accuracy on known-defect clips is unmeasured, and one camera-movement flag was disputed during independent frame inspection. Use it as a second pair of eyes, not a final verdict.
